items.title: Demolition Control Application - DC25/001/C/AA, 153 Courtland Avenue East, DSD-2025-092

items.title: Demolition Control Application - DC25/002/C/AS, 101 Clive Rd, DSD-2025-107, DSD-2025-107
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report, DSD-2025-107, dated March 5, 2025, recommending approval of Demolition Control Application DC25/002/C/AS for the property municipally addressed as 101 Clive Road. 

It was noted any recommendation arising from this matter will be considered at a Special Council meeting later this date.

items.title: Kitchener 2051 - Evaluating Approaches to Growth, DSD-2025-084
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report, DSD-2025-084, dated March 7, 2025, recommending that the Community Parameters and Technical Evaluation Criteria as presented in Development Services Department report, DSD-2025-084, be used to inform continued community and collaborator engagement on Kitchener 2051 and approaches to growth.

J. Zunic, Senior Planner provided an overview of the report. T. Donegani, Senior Planner, N. Goss, Manager of Policy and Research, and R. Bustamante, Director of Planning and Housing Policies were also in attendance to respond to questions from the Committee. 

Mayor B. Vrbanovic left the meeting at this time. 

In response to questions from the Committee, T. Donegani advised Phase 3 of the Kitchener 2051 Engagement, as outlined in Development Services Department Report DSD-2025-091, will focus on discussions regarding growth strategies. It was noted this phase will include a range of community engagement initiatives, such as community conversation kits, interactive in-person and online engagement, ongoing dialogue with First Nations, and monthly meetings with the Community Working Group.

Mayor B. Vrbanovic returned to the meeting at this time.
